final: WITH linked AS (SELECT ab.abhvreg, t.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM linked GROUP BY tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_count FROM type_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.cnt, CAST(tc.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_count as share FROM type_counts tc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_sh FROM with_shares) SELECT ws.tradekind, ws.cnt, ws.share, ws.share - av.avg_sh as share_minus_avg FROM with_shares ws CROSS JOIN avg_share av WHERE av.avg_sh IS NOT NULL AND ws.share > av.avg_sh ORDER BY ws.share DESC
